turn2.text: The **Danube** is the longest of the three, at roughly 2,850 km (1,770 miles). It rises in the Black Forest region of southwestern Germany and flows east through Austria, Slovakia, Hungary, Croatia, Serbia

turn3.text: The **Rhine** is the shortest of the three, at about 1,230 km (765 miles). It rises in the Swiss Alps and flows north through Switzerland, Germany, and the Netherlands, where it empties into the North
